sanskrit: aganma devāḥ svaḥ svar aganma- -aganma jyotir jyotir aganma | mahendro 'si parameṣṭhī sumitra viśvatomukha mā te yuyoma saṃdṛśaḥ ||
english: We have reached the gods, we have reached the heavenly realm — we have reached the light, we have reached the light. You are Mahendra, Parameṣṭhin, Sumitrā, Viśvatomukha; may we never be sundered from your sight.

sanskrit: udyann adya citramahaḥ sapatnān me 'va jahi | divainān raśmibhir jahi rātryenāṃs tamasā vadhīs te yantv adhamaṃ tamaḥ ||
english: O you of wondrous greatness, rising today, smite down my rivals. Smite them by day with your rays; let Night slay them with darkness — may they go to the lowest darkness.

sanskrit: sūryasyāvṛtam anvāvarte dakṣiṇām anvāvṛtam | agnes tejasā tejasvī bhūyāsam indrasyendriyeṇendriyāvān bhūyāsam ||
english: I turn in accordance with the course of Sūrya, I turn in accordance with the southward course. May I become radiant with the brilliance of Agni; may I become endowed with power through the might of Indra.

sanskrit: idam aham agnes tejasā- -indrasyendriyeṇa somasya dyumnena viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ kratūnām | amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasya- -amuṣyāḥ putrasya varcas teja indriyaṃ prāṇam āyur ni veṣṭayāmi ||
english: With the brilliance of Agni, with the might of Indra, with the splendor of Soma, with the efficacy of all the gods — I now wind round and bind away the luster, the radiance, the vital power, the life-breath, and the lifespan of that man, son of such a woman, from such a family.

sanskrit: (…) āyur ni yacchet ||
english: (…) may he restrain his lifespan.

sanskrit: idam aham agnes tejasā- -indrasyendriyeṇa somasya dyumnena viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ kratūnām | amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasya- -amuṣyāḥ putrasya varcas teja indriyaṃ prāṇam āyur ā dāya ||
english: With the brilliance of Agni, with the might of Indra, with the splendor of Soma, with the efficacy of all the gods — I now take away and claim for myself the luster, the radiance, the vital power, the life-breath, and the lifespan of that man, son of such a woman, from such a family.

sanskrit: abhūtyā enaṃ pāśe sitvā duṣvapnyena saṃsṛjya mṛtyor vyātta āsann api dadhāmi ||
english: Having bound him in the noose of ill-fortune and entangled him with evil dreams, I place him within the gaping mouth of Death.

sanskrit: yo naḥ svo yo araṇo bhrātṛvyaś ca jighāṃsati | indraś ca tasyāgniś ca marma skandheṣu vindatām ||
english: He who seeks to slay us — whether one of our own, or a stranger, or a rival kinsman — may Indra and Agni find his vital spots in his shoulders.

sanskrit: yo mā śayānaṃ jāgrataṃ yaś ca suptaṃ jighāṃsati | indraś ca tasyāgniś ca bāhū marmaṇi vṛścatām ||
english: He who seeks to slay me when I am lying awake, and he who seeks to slay me when I am asleep — may Indra and Agni cut into his arms at the vital joints.

sanskrit: yo mā carantaṃ tiṣṭhantam āsīnaṃ ca jighāṃsati | indraś ca tasminn agniś ca duritaṃ prati muñcatām ||
english: He who seeks to slay me while I am walking, while I am standing, or while I am sitting — may Indra and Agni discharge evil back upon him.

sanskrit: yo mā cakṣuṣā manasā yaś ca vācā jighāṃsati | indraś ca tasmā agniś ca- -enāṃsi vahatām itaḥ ||
english: He who seeks to slay me with his eye, he who seeks to slay me with his mind, and he who seeks to slay me with his speech — may Indra and Agni carry away his sins from this place.

sanskrit: yaḥ piśāco yātudhānaḥ kravyād yo mā jighāṃsati | indraś ca tasyāgniś ca mūrdhānaṃ prati vidhyatām ||
english: The piśāca, the yātudhāna, the flesh-devouring demon who seeks to slay me — may Indra and Agni pierce his head through.

sanskrit: yo mā brahmaṇā tapasā yaś ca yajñair jighāṃsati | indraś ca tasyāgniś ca hṛdaye 'dhi ni vidhyatām ||
english: He who seeks to slay me by means of sacred knowledge, by means of ascetic heat, and he who seeks to slay me by means of sacrifices — may Indra and Agni pierce him through and through in his heart.

sanskrit: yo me brahma yo me tapo balaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jighāṃsati | indraś ca tasmā agniś ca kruddhau digdhābhir asyatām ||
english: He who seeks to slay my sacred power, my ascetic heat, my foremost strength — may Indra and Agni, both wrathful, shoot their envenomed arrows at him.

sanskrit: yo me annaṃ yo me rasaṃ vācaṃ śreṣṭhāṃ jighāṃsati | indraś ca tasmā agniś ca- -ācchambaṭkāram asyatām ||
english: He who seeks to destroy my food, my vital sap, my foremost speech — may Indra and Agni hurl the śambaṭkāra curse at him.

sanskrit: yo me tantuṃ yo me prajāṃ cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ jighāṃsati | indraś ca tasmā agniś ca hetiṃ deveṣu vindatām ||
english: He who seeks to destroy my lineage, my offspring, my sight, my hearing — may Indra and Agni find for him the divine weapon among the gods.

sanskrit: yo me gobhya irasyaty aśvebhyaḥ puruṣebhyaḥ | indraś ca tasmā agniś ca jyāniṃ deveṣu vindatām ||
english: He who envies me my cattle, my horses, my men — may Indra and Agni find for him loss and ruin among the gods.

sanskrit: yo me bhūtim anāmayad vittam āyur jighāṃsati | indraś ca tasmā agniś ca divo aśmānam asyatām ||
english: He who seeks to destroy my prosperity free from disease, my wealth, my lifespan — may Indra and Agni hurl the stone of heaven at him.

sanskrit: yo me veśma yo me sabhāṃ śriyaṃ śreṣṭhāṃ jighāṃsati | indraś ca tasyāgniś ca kṛtyāṃ vi tanutāṃ gṛhe ||
english: He who seeks to destroy my house, my assembly hall, my foremost glory — may Indra and Agni spread the sorcery-curse back through his own home.

sanskrit: yo me mṛtyum asamṛddhim ahnā rātryā cecchati | indraś ca tasyāgniś ca- -arciṣā dahatāṃ svam ||
english: He who wishes upon me death and ill-fortune by day and by night — may Indra and Agni burn his own self with their flames.

sanskrit: yo me prāṇaṃ yo me 'pānaṃ vyānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jighāṃsati | indraś ca tasyāgniś ca prāṇaṃ prāṇahanau hatām ||
english: He who seeks to destroy my in-breath, my out-breath, my foremost diffused breath — may Indra and Agni smite his breath with the breath-slayer.

sanskrit: yo mā devajanaiḥ sarpair vidyutā brahmaṇābhyamāt | agastyena medinā- -indraś cāgniś ca taṃ hatām ||
english: He who has oppressed me through divine beings, through serpents, through lightning, through sacred lore — with Agastya as ally, may Indra and Agni slay him.

sanskrit: taṃ satyaujāḥ pra dahatv agnir vaiśvānaro vṛṣā | yo mā durasyann īkṣātai yaś ca dipsati vidvalaḥ ||
english: Let Agni Vaiśvānara, the bull of true might, burn that one utterly — he who regards me with ill intent and he who, knowing, seeks to harm me.

sanskrit: yo mā dipsād adipsantaṃ yaś ca dipsati dipsa tam | vaiśvānarasya daṃṣṭrayor agner api dadhāmi tam ||
english: He who would harm me though I have not harmed him, and he who seeks to harm the one who seeks to harm — I place him between the fangs of Agni Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit: abhi taṃ dyāvāpṛthivī saṃtapatāṃ tapte gharme nyucyatām | nirṛtyā vadhyatāṃ pāśe yo naḥ pāpaṃ cikitsati ||
english: Let Heaven-and-Earth scorch him from every side; let him be flung down upon the heated cauldron. Let him be slain by Nirṛti's noose — he who devises evil against us.

sanskrit: pratyagvadhena pracyutān bhrātṛvyān ghoracakṣasaḥ | indrāgnī enān vṛścatāṃ maiṣām uc cheṣi kaś cana ||
english: These rivals, of dreadful aspect, hurled back by the counter-blow — may Indra and Agni cut them apart; let not one of them survive.

sanskrit: pratyagvadha pratyag jahi bhrātṛvyān dviṣato mama | apānān prāṇāṃ saṃchidya dviṣatas pātayādharān ||
english: O counter-blow, strike back, smite back my hateful rivals. Severing their out-breath from their in-breath, cast those who hate me downward.

sanskrit: agne ye mā jighāṃsanty agne ye ca dviṣanti mā | agne ye mopatapyante teṣāṃ priyatamaṃ jahi ||
english: O Agni, those who seek to slay me, O Agni, those who hate me, O Agni, those who oppress me — smite the one dearest to them.

sanskrit: etaṃ dviṣantam avadhiṣam andhena tamasāvṛtam | etaṃ mṛtyo 'bhi padyasva mā te moci mahodaraḥ ||
english: This one who hated me I have struck down, wrapped in blind darkness. Fall upon this one, O Mṛtyu — let not the great-bellied one be released from you.
